name: Zone I · Scene 2: The Cosmic Boss — Earth, Sky, Sea & The Unbathing Bear
greek: Ἐν μὲν γαῖαν ἔτευξ᾽, ἐν δ᾽ οὐρανόν, ἐν δὲ θάλασσαν, Ἠέλιόν τ᾽ ἀκάμαντα Σελήνην τε πλήθουσαν, ἐν δὲ τὰ τείρεα πάντα, τά τ᾽ οὐρανὸς ἐστεφάνωται, Πληϊάδας θ᾽ Ὑάδας τε τό τε σθένος Ὠρίωνος Ἄρκτον θ᾽, ἣν καὶ Ἄμαξαν ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν, ἥ τ᾽ αὐτοῦ στρέφεται καί τ᾽ Ὠρίωνα δοκεύει, οἴη δ᾽ ἄμμορός ἐστι λοετρῶν Ὠκεανοῖο.
buckley: On it he wrought the earth, and the heaven, and the sea, the unwearied sun, and the full moon; on it also, all the constellations with which the heaven is crowned, the Pleiades, the Hyades, and the might of Orion, and the Bear, which they also call by the appellation of the Wain, which there revolves, and watches Orion; but it alone is without a share of the baths of the ocean.

worldModel.vision: Central golden omphalos dome surrounded by kyanos sky (272), emerald earth (2), golden Sun (297/46), silver full Moon (179), and star-stud constellations (11609).
worldModel.memory: Invariance law: The Bear/Wain (Ἄρκτος) revolves perpetually around the polar axis watching Orion, constrained never to dip below the horizon of Oceanus.
worldModel.controller: Cosmological clockwork anchoring all mortal time and agricultural seasons in the outer rings.

shots.name: Earth, Heaven, and Sea
shots.beat: On the central boss Hephaestus fashions the earth, the overarching heaven, and the deep sea.

shots.name: Unwearied Sun & Full Moon
shots.beat: The tireless golden Sun and the full silver Moon shine together across the vault.

shots.name: The Bear Revolves Watching Orion
shots.beat: The Bear, called the Wain, revolves in place and watches Orion, alone having no share in the baths of Oceanus.
